basic_profile.bio: EddiesBurned is a seasoned gamer and tech enthusiast from Seattle, Washington. They have a deep passion for immersive RPGs and a knack for min-maxing character builds in games like Cyberpunk 2077. By day, they work as a software developer, specializing in AI systems, and by night, they transform into a digital nomad exploring the vast worlds of virtual landscapes. They are in a long-term relationship and often collaborate on gaming content with their partner during the evenings. EddiesBurned typically spends their online hours from 6 PM to midnight PST, diving into discussions about game mechanics and occasionally venturing into educational subreddits to satisfy their curiosity about the latest tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: EddiesBurned has a strong foundation in computer science with a degree from a reputable university. They have honed their expertise in software development through a combination of formal education and self-taught programming projects. Their deep dive into gaming mechanics is driven by a personal interest in understanding the intricacies of game design and player engagement. They often share insights gained from both professional experiences and personal gaming exploits.
